M.name: Noosa Bar
M.src: BoM gauge 540311 (Noosa Bar): 13 highs/13 lows over 7 days matched to Noosa Head predictions; HW lag sd 16 min, LW lag sd 27 min; lows are flat at this gauge (sensor or channel dries) so low-water timing/height come from neighbouring calibration

M.name: Lake Cooroibah
M.src: BoM gauge 540309 (Noosa River at Lake Cooroibah): 9 highs/6 lows over 7 days matched to Noosa Head predictions; HW lag sd 30 min, LW lag sd 37 min; lows are flat at this gauge (sensor or channel dries) so low-water timing/height come from neighbouring calibration

M.name: Tidal limit (est.)
M.src: Generic extrapolation 28.5 km beyond the last calibration: median lag growth of all calibrated QLD places/gauges in this region (HW +2.0, LW +2.7 min/km); at a natural tidal limit highs ≈ 0.15 m lower than downstream and lows drain out (water-starts-rising, like upper Baffle)
